issues.where: the sea and cloud field left of and below the island
issues.what: the scattered white cumulus clusters of -a are replaced by streaked, blocky, glinting patches that read as broken sun-glint or smeared texture rather than cloud over the sea
issues.fix: restore discrete soft cumulus clusters in the -a pattern (rows trending NE), with soft edges and cast shadows; keep any motion blur directional and soft, not blocky

issues.where: above the island centre, drifting up toward the top edge
issues.what: the white vapour plumes streaming off the land are gone
issues.fix: bring back the long thin curling vapour streamers rising from the island toward the upper middle of frame

issues.what: the curling white vapour plumes are gone
issues.fix: restore the thin white vapour streamers looping down from the top edge into the right-hand land

issues.where: over the crater lake from the upper-right rim
issues.what: the white vapour wisp blowing across the lake is gone
issues.fix: restore the thin white plume spilling off the upper-right rim over the water

issues.what: the rust-red plain pocked with many dark round pits and pools is replaced by red ridged mountains with no pits
issues.fix: flatten that area back to a rust-brown plain studded with many dark circular pools of varied size

issues.where: rust zone between the island and the ribbed ridges
issues.what: the dark round pits in the rust ground are gone, replaced by ridged red mountains
issues.fix: restore the pitted rust-brown plain with scattered dark circular pools

issues.where: large irregular lake right of centre
issues.what: the frilly pale ring of crenellated rim around the lake is gone; the lake is a plain dark blot
issues.fix: give the lake its pale lacy fringed shore and the encircling raised ring of -a

issues.where: the irregular lake right of the main crater
issues.what: lacks the pale frilly rim and ring of -a; reads as a flat dark heart shape
issues.fix: add the lacy pale crenellated shoreline ring

issues.where: the cluster of dark lakes right of and above the main crater
issues.what: the group of three or four dark lakes and the large crater lake at top become one small lake and a small oval; the crater lake at top has lost its broad dark shaded basin
issues.fix: restore the cluster of several merging dark lakes and the wide shallow crater basin at top

issues.what: popcorn cumulus clusters become torn, flat, sharp-edged flakes and smears
issues.fix: make the clouds rounded soft cumulus puffs in clusters, as in -a

issues.where: ochre shoreline of the crater lake
issues.what: the ochre sediment swirls and tendrils curling into the dark water (notably the lower-left hook) are gone; a flat uniform brown band remains
issues.fix: break the ochre band into swirling plumes and tendrils reaching into the lake, thinner on the east shore

issues.where: where the river meets the lake, top left
issues.what: the braided delta fan is gone and the river ends on a hard straight edge into the brown band
issues.fix: restore a small pale braided delta where the river spreads into the lake

issues.what: the deep blue sea with white surf and cloud streaks becomes a flat teal lagoon with no surf or cloud
issues.fix: restore the deeper blue water with white streaky surf/cloud along it

issues.what: loses its crater bowl and ochre fringe; becomes a plain dark lake on flat beige ground
issues.fix: set the lake back in a rimmed crater bowl with ochre sediment fringing and a channel through it

issues.where: southern coast of the island and the inlets below it
issues.what: the frilly dark inlets of -a become murky haze with small lakes ringed in a bright cyan glow
issues.fix: drop the cyan halos and restore crisp dark fingered inlets along a fringed coastline

issues.what: the cool lavender-grey ground of -a has become warmer beige with harder, deeper ridge shadows
issues.fix: cool the land toward grey-violet and soften shadow contrast

issues.what: the ochre swirl inside the lower-left of the lake is gone and the rim is a plain ring
issues.fix: add the curling ochre tendril into the water

issues.what: overall darker and dimmer than -a; land midtones lose their silvery sheen
issues.fix: lift exposure slightly and add the pale silver highlight on the ridges
